sourceAttempts.family: Blackstone River Watershed Council river access and portage map
sourceAttempts.result: The current access page documents Kelly House, Pratt Dam above and below-dam access, Central Falls Landing and Chocolateville as public water-entry or portage sites, with approximate downstream distances and dam boundaries.
RiverScout provides a 200–1,200 cfs Class I–II planning window tied to direct USGS 01112500 at Woonsocket.
The existing Blackstone at Pawtucket government photograph is reused as an explicitly same-river context image for each new route.
